investigations.name: merks-ecm-reciprocity-2d
investigations.title: Cell-ECM mechanical reciprocity (Merks 3D CPM-ECM, 2D real-engine reproduction — FAILS: coupling gap)
investigations.question:
Can we reproduce the cell-ECM mechanical-reciprocity phenomena of Keijzer &
Merks 2026 (arXiv:2609.02375, a 3D hybrid cellular Potts model coupled to a
discrete deformable fiber network — code unreleased) by driving the REAL
published 2D ancestor engine (Tsingos et al. 2023 static-adhesion TST-MD)
on ordinary hardware?
investigations.hypothesis:
The 3D paper extends a published, open 2D engine. Bridged and run CPU-only,
that real engine should reproduce — at the mechanism level, in 2D — the same
reciprocity phenomena: a contractile cell deforms a crosslinked bead-spring
ECM, fibers reorient toward the cell (q/q0 > 1), and crosslinking builds
network connectivity (percolation).
